 --> Subscribe for SFC Environmental Technologies Ltd IPO; Geojit Financial Services
 Geojit Financial Services, has come out with its report on SFC Environmental Technologies Ltd The research firm has recommended to “ Subscribe” the ipo in its research report as on October 27, 2026. 
 Broker Research
 October 28, 2026 / 10:21 IST Share --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 IPO 
 Geojit Financial Services, SFC Environmental Technologies Ltd 
 SFC Environmental Technologies (SFC), incorporated in 2005, manufactures wastewater treatment equipment built on its proprietary C-Tech sequencing batch reactor (SBR) technology, with 728 installations, over 80% of India's SBR market and 17,511 MLD treated as of July 2026. India’s sewage treatment market is projected to grow at ~9.6% CAGR through FY30, while tertiary treatment is expected to surge at ~30.3% CAGR to ₹70.1 bn by FY31. SFC operates across four key business segments, led by Wastewater Treatment (WWT), which contributed ~67.5% of FY26 revenue. Solid Waste Treatment (SWT) accounted for ~17.4%, focusing on municipal waste processing and compressed biogas projects, while electrical and automation solutions through Chavare contributed ~13.3%. Wastewater Recycling & Reuse (WRR) formed the remaining ~1.8%, supported by the exclusive distribution of DuPont membranes in India. SFC supplies technology to EPC contractors bidding for Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) projects rather than executing EPC itself, avoiding civil and site risk. Materials absorb ~50% of revenue against 80-90% for EPC players, supporting a ~29% EBITDA margin against 5-10% for peers. Revenue grew from ₹657.5cr in FY24 to ₹803.6cr in FY26 with EBITDA margin ~ 29% and PAT at ₹160.2cr. ROE was 21.5% and ROCE 22.3% in FY26. Installations grew from 577 in FY24 to 724 by June 2026, and repeat customers were 91.98% of FY26 standalone revenue against 85.18% in FY25, reflecting how sticky C-Tech is once specified. As of August 2026, SFC's order book stood at ₹1,656.6cr, ~2x FY26 revenue – WWT ~39%, WRR ~34% and SWT ~27% – giving medium-term revenue visibility. Of the ₹150cr fresh issue, ₹42.2cr prepays borrowings and ₹74.9cr funds working capital, lowering debt/equity from 0.30x in FY26 to 0.25x post-issue.
 Valuation and Outlook 
 At the upper price band of ₹330, SFC is valued at ~21x FY26 EPS, a discount to listed peers, backed by SBR technology leadership, order-book visibility, healthy margins, strong return ratios and low leverage. We recommend a 'Subscribe' rating for a medium- to long-term horizon.
